item.text: {"actions":[{"action":"Preserve item focus; define a removal destination","mechanism":"Stable product and control identities preserve focus through reordering; removed items send focus to the results heading.","implementation":"Key elements by product ID and control role. Before updating, capture focus. Restore only if disrupted; use a programmatically focusable results heading when removed.","check":"Reorder a retained focused product: the same control stays focused. Filter it out: focus reaches the heading. Filter controls retain focus.","risk":"Unconditional restoration can steal focus after the user moves elsewhere."},{"action":"Separate loading, count, and empty states","mechanism":"A persistent textual status exposes the latest count without moving focus; explicit loading text distinguishes pending results from zero.","implementation":"Keep status outside the busy results container. Show “Updating; previous count: N.” On arrival, update the visible count and polite live region within one second.","check":"Measure arrival-to-status latency. Test slow responses, zero matches, and nonzero matches with keyboard and screen reader; loading must never announce zero prematurely.","risk":"Assistive technology may delay speech despite timely live-region updates."},{"action":"Commit only the newest complete result update","mechanism":"Versioned, atomic updates prevent stale responses from reversing the count, item order, or focus destination.","implementation":"Assign each filter request a sequence number. Ignore older responses. Commit items, count, loading state, and the focus policy together for the latest request.","check":"Resolve two requests in reverse order. Only the latest appears. Repeat with a retained focused item and a removed one; verify the defined destinations.","risk":"Rejecting stale responses must not leave loading active after failure."},{"action":"Offer a compact view without hiding matches","mechanism":"Reducing card detail, rather than product coverage, gives users a less expansive way to browse the same results.","implementation":"Add a keyboard-operable compact-view toggle. Retain every matching product, its name, distinguishing variant labels, and details link; hide only supplementary previews.","check":"Compare product IDs and counts across views: they must match. Reach every details link by keyboard; verify variant distinctions remain readable without color.","risk":"Over-simplified labels can make distinct products indistinguishable; retain distinguishing information."}],"abstention_reason":""}
